name: Cipla Nicotex Nicotine Sugar Free Mint Plus Gums 4Mg 12 Gums Each Pack | Helps To Quit Smoking - Who | Approved Therapy
description:
Cipla Nicotex Nicotine Sugar-Free Gum 4mg – Mint Plus

Kickstart your journey to a smoke-free life with Cipla Nicotex Nicotine Gum. This WHO-approved nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) supports a 12-week program designed to help you reduce dependence on cigarettes while doubling your chances of quitting successfully.

Key Features:

Helps Quit Smoking: Assists in gradually reducing nicotine dependence.

WHO-Approved Therapy: Safe and clinically recognized nicotine replacement.

Doctor Recommended: India’s No. 1 recommended brand by doctors.

Sugar-Free & Flavored: Mint Plus flavor; also available in Paan, Cinnamon, Fruit Burst, and Ultra Mint.

Pack Size: 12 gums per pack

12-Week Program: Structured therapy to guide you toward a smoke-free life.

Regain control of your health with Cipla Nicotex Nicotine Gum 4mg – Mint Plus.
